<MethodEndpoint

  path={"/v1/compose/start"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Starts the stack's exited services (all, or `services`) in dependency order with the
settings they were created with. Running services are left alone. A service that never
had a container is an error: `compose up` creates it.
